def name():
    name = request.args.get('name', '')
    # Validate: ensure name is a non-empty string with only alphanumeric characters, spaces, and basic punctuation
    if not isinstance(name, str) or not name.strip():
        name = "Guest"
    else:
        # Remove any potentially dangerous characters for HTML context
        import re
        name = re.sub(r'[<>]', '', name)
        name = name.strip()
        if not name:
            name = "Guest"
    
    response = make_response(f"Hello, {name}!")
    response.headers['Content-Type'] = 'text/html; charset=utf-8'
    return response
